articles.title: China's Yiwu is becoming a must-visit for global shoppers
articles.titleCn: 中国义乌正成为全球购物者的必游之地
articles.summary: This summer, Yiwu International Trade Market in east China's Zhejiang Province has been bustling with overseas buyers and tourists, turning the city into a unique destination where international visitors can experience China's products, technology and manufacturing capabilities firsthand.
articles.summaryCn: 义乌国际商贸城吸引大量海外游客，展示中国制造与创新，推动购物旅游发展。

paragraphs.en: This summer, Yiwu International Trade Market in east China's Zhejiang Province has been {{0}} with overseas buyers and tourists, turning the city into a unique {{1}} where international visitors can experience China's products, technology and {{2}} capabilities firsthand. Known as the world's largest wholesale market for small {{3}}, Yiwu is increasingly becoming a window into China's fast-{{4}} manufacturing and consumer markets. For many foreign visitors, a trip to the city is no longer simply about sightseeing – it is about shopping and discovering what is new in China. At the market, a Syrian tourist who asked to be called Saed tried out a range of high-tech products, including dancing robots, {{5}} robotic dogs and a new-generation robotic {{6}}. "It's better than I expected.
paragraphs.cn: 今年夏天，位于中国东部浙江省的义乌国际商贸城迎来了大量海外买家和游客，使这座城市成为一个独特的旅游目的地，国际游客可以在这里亲身体验中国的产品、技术和制造能力。义乌被誉为全球最大的小商品批发市场，正日益成为中国快速发展的制造业和消费市场的窗口。对许多外国游客来说，来这座城市不再仅仅是观光——而是购物和发现中国的新事物。在市场上，一位要求被称为萨伊德的叙利亚游客试用了多种高科技产品，包括跳舞机器人、互动机器狗和新一代机器人外骨骼。他说：“这比我预期的要好。”

paragraphs.en:
Honestly, it's {{7}}," Saed said. "There are a variety of products in the city. I traveled a lot. In other countries, you don't see this level of development. I've already been shocked."
In the first half of 2026, Yiwu International Trade Market received an average of 294,000 visits a day, up 34% year on year.
paragraphs.cn: “说实话，这令人震惊，”萨伊德说。“这座城市有各种各样的产品。我去过很多地方旅行。在其他国家，你看不到这种发展水平。我已经被震撼了。”2026年上半年，义乌国际商贸城日均接待游客29.4万人次，同比增长34%。

paragraphs.en: Overseas visitors averaged 12,000 a day, an increase of 30%. For international visitors, the market offers much more than a one-stop shopping experience. They can try AI-powered customized products, smart toys and other emerging consumer products while getting a close-up look at the speed and {{8}} of Chinese manufacturing. As he explored the market and tried out various smart devices and {{9}} products, Saed was struck by the pace of China's technological development. "I think people should come to China every year, or even every few months, to keep up with the technology, because the technology is developing way too fast," said Saed.
paragraphs.cn: 海外游客日均1.2万人次，增长30%。对国际游客来说，这个市场提供的远不止一站式购物体验。他们可以试用人工智能定制的产品、智能玩具和其他新兴消费品，同时近距离了解中国制造业的速度和活力。在探索市场并试用各种智能设备和创新产品时，萨伊德对中国技术发展的速度感到震惊。萨伊德说：“我认为人们应该每年甚至每隔几个月来一次中国，以跟上技术的发展，因为技术发展得太快了。”

paragraphs.en:
Syrian tourist Saed speaks with China Media Group after trying out high-tech products in Yiwu, Jinhua City, east China's Zhejiang Province. /CMG
From low-cost goods to rapid innovation
The {{10}} of visitors has also brought more business to local {{11}}. "During the summer holiday, customer traffic has increased by about 50% year on year," said Li Shujun, a merchant at Yiwu International Trade Market. "We're seeing quite a lot of customers from Brazil, Argentina and Chile."
An expanding range of technology-driven products is helping Yiwu attract buyers with increasingly {{12}} needs. "Chinese AI products are particularly attractive," said a merchant named Ruan Xiaolong.
paragraphs.cn:
叙利亚游客萨伊德在浙江省金华市义乌试用高科技产品后与中国媒体集团交谈。/CMG
从低价商品到快速创新
游客的涌入也给当地商家带来了更多生意。“暑假期间，客流量同比增长了约50%，”义乌国际商贸城的商户李淑君说。“我们看到很多来自巴西、阿根廷和智利的客户。”不断扩大的技术驱动产品范围正在帮助义乌吸引需求日益多样化的买家。“中国的人工智能产品特别有吸引力，”一位名叫阮小龙的商户说。

paragraphs.en:
"Today's robots can speak multiple languages, and some even have their own {{13}} and facial {{14}}."
Yiwu's ability to respond quickly to changing consumer demand can also be seen in seemingly ordinary products. During the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States, Canada and Mexico, a China-made fan hat that provides both shade and airflow unexpectedly went viral on social media. By early July, overseas orders for the product had {{15}} 700,000 units. The {{16}} of a simple hat – becoming lighter and more {{17}} while adding new functions – reflects a broader shift in the way Yiwu products compete globally. Innovation in Yiwu is no longer driven {{18}} by individual merchants coming up with new ideas.
paragraphs.cn:
“今天的机器人能说多种语言，有些甚至有自己的情感和面部表情。”
义乌对不断变化的消费需求的快速响应能力也体现在看似普通的产品上。在2026年美国、加拿大和墨西哥举办的FIFA世界杯期间，一款既能遮阳又能通风的中国制造风扇帽意外在社交媒体上走红。到7月初，该产品的海外订单已超过70万件。一顶简单的帽子不断演变——变得更轻、更紧凑，同时增加新功能——反映了义乌产品在全球竞争方式的更广泛转变。义乌的创新不再仅仅由个体商户提出新想法来驱动。

paragraphs.en:
In 2025, the city granted nearly 9,000 {{19}} and newly recognized more than 100 enterprise research and development institutions at various levels. Merchant Long Xijin said his company launches hundreds of new products every year. New designs are first tested in stores to {{20}} market response, with resources then focused on products that prove popular. "Overseas customers believe Chinese products are {{21}} evolving through research and innovation," Long said. "They are also willing to share their ideas and new concepts with us, and we use their needs to guide our product development."
Zhang Chenggang, head of the Institute for Social Governance and Development at Tsinghua University, said Yiwu's {{22}} edge has evolved considerably.
paragraphs.cn: 2025年，该市授予近9000项专利，并新认定100多家各级企业研发机构。商户龙希金表示，他的公司每年推出数百种新产品。新设计首先在商店进行测试，以评估市场反应，然后将资源集中在受欢迎的产品上。“海外客户相信中国产品通过研究和创新不断发展，”龙说。“他们也愿意与我们分享他们的想法和新概念，我们用他们的需求来指导产品开发。”清华大学社会治理与发展研究院院长张成刚表示，义乌的竞争优势已经发生了显著变化。

paragraphs.en:
"If Yiwu's advantage in the past was mainly reflected in price, its core competitiveness today lies in a {{23}} of quality, innovation and the ability to respond quickly to market demand," Zhang said. "Yiwu's small commodities have long moved beyond simple price competition and entered a new stage centered on value creation and understanding consumers' needs."
Foreign visitors shop for goods at Yiwu International Trade Market, Jinhua City, east China's Zhejiang Province, August 4, 2026. Policy support is also making Yiwu more attractive to international visitors. Measures such as China's 240-hour visa-free transit policy and "instant tax refunds upon purchase" for eligible departing travelers have further enhanced the city's appeal. The number of tax-refund stores in Yiwu has increased from seven to 42, with 28 offering instant refunds at the point of purchase.
paragraphs.cn:
“如果义乌过去的优势主要体现在价格上，那么今天的核心竞争力在于质量、创新和快速响应市场需求的能力的结合，”张说。“义乌的小商品早已超越简单的价格竞争，进入了一个以价值创造和理解消费者需求为中心的新阶段。”
外国游客在浙江省金华市义乌国际商贸城购物，2026年8月4日。政策支持也使义乌对国际游客更具吸引力。中国的240小时过境免签政策和符合条件的离境旅客“即买即退”等措施进一步提升了这座城市的吸引力。义乌的退税商店数量从7家增加到42家，其中28家提供即时退税。

paragraphs.en: The growing popularity of "shopping tourism" has helped boost Yiwu's tourism sector, with the city generating 17.45 billion yuan ($2.59 billion) in tourism revenue in the first half of 2026, up 10.2% year on year. From robots and smart gadgets to everyday goods with unexpectedly creative designs, Yiwu offers international visitors a {{24}} of how quickly Chinese products are evolving – and why more and more travelers are coming to China with room in their luggage for much more than souvenirs.
paragraphs.cn: “购物旅游”的日益普及促进了义乌旅游业的发展，2026年上半年该市实现旅游收入174.5亿元人民币（25.9亿美元），同比增长10.2%。从机器人和智能小工具到设计出人意料创意的日常用品，义乌为国际游客提供了中国产品快速发展的缩影——以及为什么越来越多的游客带着行李箱来中国，而不仅仅是装纪念品。

articles.fullText:
This summer, Yiwu International Trade Market in east China's Zhejiang Province has been bustling with overseas buyers and tourists, turning the city into a unique destination where international visitors can experience China's products, technology and manufacturing capabilities firsthand.
Known as the world's largest wholesale market for small commodities, Yiwu is increasingly becoming a window into China's fast-evolving manufacturing and consumer markets. For many foreign visitors, a trip to the city is no longer simply about sightseeing – it is about shopping and discovering what is new in China.
At the market, a Syrian tourist who asked to be called Saed tried out a range of high-tech products, including dancing robots, interactive robotic dogs and a new-generation robotic exoskeleton.
"It's better than I expected. Honestly, it's shocking," Saed said. "There are a variety of products in the city. I traveled a lot. In other countries, you don't see this level of development. I've already been shocked."
In the first half of 2026, Yiwu International Trade Market received an average of 294,000 visits a day, up 34% year on year. Overseas visitors averaged 12,000 a day, an increase of 30%.
For international visitors, the market offers much more than a one-stop shopping experience. They can try AI-powered customized products, smart toys and other emerging consumer products while getting a close-up look at the speed and dynamism of Chinese manufacturing.
As he explored the market and tried out various smart devices and innovative products, Saed was struck by the pace of China's technological development.
"I think people should come to China every year, or even every few months, to keep up with the technology, because the technology is developing way too fast," said Saed.
Syrian tourist Saed speaks with China Media Group after trying out high-tech products in Yiwu, Jinhua City, east China's Zhejiang Province. /CMG
From low-cost goods to rapid innovation
The influx of visitors has also brought more business to local merchants.
"During the summer holiday, customer traffic has increased by about 50% year on year," said Li Shujun, a merchant at Yiwu International Trade Market. "We're seeing quite a lot of customers from Brazil, Argentina and Chile."
An expanding range of technology-driven products is helping Yiwu attract buyers with increasingly diverse needs.
"Chinese AI products are particularly attractive," said a merchant named Ruan Xiaolong. "Today's robots can speak multiple languages, and some even have their own emotions and facial expressions."
Yiwu's ability to respond quickly to changing consumer demand can also be seen in seemingly ordinary products.
During the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States, Canada and Mexico, a China-made fan hat that provides both shade and airflow unexpectedly went viral on social media. By early July, overseas orders for the product had surpassed 700,000 units.
The evolution of a simple hat – becoming lighter and more compact while adding new functions – reflects a broader shift in the way Yiwu products compete globally.
Innovation in Yiwu is no longer driven solely by individual merchants coming up with new ideas. In 2025, the city granted nearly 9,000 patents and newly recognized more than 100 enterprise research and development institutions at various levels.
Merchant Long Xijin said his company launches hundreds of new products every year. New designs are first tested in stores to gauge market response, with resources then focused on products that prove popular.
"Overseas customers believe Chinese products are constantly evolving through research and innovation," Long said. "They are also willing to share their ideas and new concepts with us, and we use their needs to guide our product development."
Zhang Chenggang, head of the Institute for Social Governance and Development at Tsinghua University, said Yiwu's competitive edge has evolved considerably.
"If Yiwu's advantage in the past was mainly reflected in price, its core competitiveness today lies in a combination of quality, innovation and the ability to respond quickly to market demand," Zhang said. "Yiwu's small commodities have long moved beyond simple price competition and entered a new stage centered on value creation and understanding consumers' needs."
Foreign visitors shop for goods at Yiwu International Trade Market, Jinhua City, east China's Zhejiang Province, August 4, 2026. 
Policy support is also making Yiwu more attractive to international visitors. Measures such as China's 240-hour visa-free transit policy and "instant tax refunds upon purchase" for eligible departing travelers have further enhanced the city's appeal. The number of tax-refund stores in Yiwu has increased from seven to 42, with 28 offering instant refunds at the point of purchase.
The growing popularity of "shopping tourism" has helped boost Yiwu's tourism sector, with the city generating 17.45 billion yuan ($2.59 billion) in tourism revenue in the first half of 2026, up 10.2% year on year.
From robots and smart gadgets to everyday goods with unexpectedly creative designs, Yiwu offers international visitors a snapshot of how quickly Chinese products are evolving – and why more and more travelers are coming to China with room in their luggage for much more than souvenirs.

articles.title: English hospitals aim to ramp up use of robotics in surgery
articles.titleCn: 英国医院计划加大机器人手术应用力度
articles.summary: The UK government has announced plans to invest more in robotic equipment for English hospitals and set a target for robotic assistance to be used in 90% of keyhole surgeries carried out in England by 2035
articles.summaryCn: 英国政府计划增加对医院机器人设备的投资，目标到2035年90%的微创手术使用机器人辅助，以提升手术精准度并缓解医疗系统压力。

paragraphs.en:
The UK government has announced plans to {{1}} more in robotic equipment for English hospitals and set a {{2}} for robotic assistance to be used in 90% of {{3}} surgeries carried out in England by 2035. The government highlighted robotics as one of five "big bets" in a 10-year health plan for England, alongside other {{4}} technologies: data, AI, genomics and wearables. Surgeons and nurses using the new Da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system while performing surgery, at St Bartholomew's Hospital in London. /Carlos Jasso/AFP
At St Bartholomew's Hospital in central London, visiting surgeons are among the first to be trained to use the new da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system, made by US company Initiative. The system, which includes three robotic arms that can hold surgical equipment, is controlled using an {{5}} 3D headset and a video-game-like {{6}}.
paragraphs.cn: 英国政府宣布计划增加对英格兰医院机器人设备的投资，并设定目标，到2035年，英格兰90%的微创手术将使用机器人辅助。政府将机器人技术列为英格兰十年健康计划中的五大“重大赌注”之一，其他变革性技术还包括数据、人工智能、基因组学和可穿戴设备。外科医生和护士在伦敦圣巴塞洛缪医院使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统进行手术。/Carlos Jasso/AFP

paragraphs.en:
Robotic surgical systems like this can be used across a range of {{7}} including urology, gynecology, abdominal, colorectal, and thoracic or general surgery. Sasha Stamenkovic (C) using the new Da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system while performing lung cancer surgery as Ali Ansaripour (R), senior cardiothoracic trainee on a robotic fellowship, looks on. /Carlos Jasso/AFP
The {{8}} of robotic-assisted surgery should mean shorter hospital stays and quicker {{9}} times, which will take {{10}} off a struggling health service with year-long waitlists, workforce shortages and discharge {{11}}. "The ability to have lots of {{12}} computer-aided technology on top" of human-controlled robotics "makes this precise surgery. It makes it safe surgery," says Sasha Stamenkovic, Director of Robotic Surgery and Research at Barts Health NHS Trust.
paragraphs.cn: 在伦敦市中心的圣巴塞洛缪医院，来访的外科医生是首批接受培训使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统的人员，该系统由美国公司Initiative制造。该系统包括三个可持手术器械的机械臂，通过沉浸式3D头戴设备和类似视频游戏的控制台进行操作。

paragraphs.en:
As well as improving recovery times, the greater precision also reduces the risk of {{13}} like air leaks, a common cause of longer hospital stays following lung surgery. Nurses assisting in lung cancer surgery using the new Da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system, at St Bartholomew's Hospital. /Carlos Jasso/AFP
Ian Macleod was the first patient in Britain's NHS to {{14}} lung cancer surgery using the new da Vinci robotic system. Macleod says he "didn't realize" until he was wearing a surgical gown and anesthetised that he would hold this {{15}} title, but the news "didn't {{16}}" the 76-year-old retired detective. Thirty minutes after the robotic-assisted operation, Macleod was back on his feet.
paragraphs.cn: 这类机器人手术系统可用于多种专科，包括泌尿科、妇科、腹部、结直肠、胸外科或普外科。Sasha Stamenkovic（中）使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统进行肺癌手术，Ali Ansaripour（右）作为机器人专科高级心胸外科培训生在一旁观看。/Carlos Jasso/AFP

He had undergone non-robotic keyhole surgery for a different cancer in the past, and says the recovery time was "much longer". articles.fullText:
The UK government has announced plans to invest more in robotic equipment for English hospitals and set a target for robotic assistance to be used in 90% of keyhole surgeries carried out in England by 2035.
The government highlighted robotics as one of five "big bets" in a 10-year health plan for England, alongside other transformative technologies: data, AI, genomics and wearables.
Surgeons and nurses using the new Da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system while performing surgery, at St Bartholomew's Hospital in London. /Carlos Jasso/AFP
At St Bartholomew's Hospital in central London, visiting surgeons are among the first to be trained to use the new da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system, made by US company Initiative. The system, which includes three robotic arms that can hold surgical equipment, is controlled using an immersive 3D headset and a video-game-like console.
Robotic surgical systems like this can be used across a range of specialties including urology, gynecology, abdominal, colorectal, and thoracic or general surgery.
Sasha Stamenkovic (C) using the new Da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system while performing lung cancer surgery as Ali Ansaripour (R), senior cardiothoracic trainee on a robotic fellowship, looks on. /Carlos Jasso/AFP
The precision of robotic-assisted surgery should mean shorter hospital stays and quicker recovery times, which will take strain off a struggling health service with year-long waitlists, workforce shortages and discharge bottlenecks.
"The ability to have lots of integrated computer-aided technology on top" of human-controlled robotics "makes this precise surgery. It makes it safe surgery," says Sasha Stamenkovic, Director of Robotic Surgery and Research at Barts Health NHS Trust.
As well as improving recovery times, the greater precision also reduces the risk of complications like air leaks, a common cause of longer hospital stays following lung surgery.
Nurses assisting in lung cancer surgery using the new Da Vinci 5 robotic-assisted surgical system, at St Bartholomew's Hospital. /Carlos Jasso/AFP
Ian Macleod was the first patient in Britain's NHS to undergo lung cancer surgery using the new da Vinci robotic system. Macleod says he "didn't realize" until he was wearing a surgical gown and anesthetised that he would hold this groundbreaking title, but the news "didn't faze" the 76-year-old retired detective.
Thirty minutes after the robotic-assisted operation, Macleod was back on his feet. "It was extraordinary," he says. "In fact, after the operation, I found out quite quickly that I only had one stitch." He had undergone non-robotic keyhole surgery for a different cancer in the past, and says the recovery time was "much longer". This time, he was driving his wife to the garden centrer for coffee less than a week later.
Stamenkovic runs fellowships at St Bartholomew's training surgeons on this new technology. He says it is the young surgeons who pick up the new robotic control system the fastest and who become the most adept.
"They've come with different skill sets," he says, "they've probably come with gaming skill sets, some of them have come with a musical background."
Laying out his long-term mission, Stamenkovic added: "All we need to do is harness their energy, their passion, their skill set, and teach them the right moves. And that will make the surgeon of the future."
articles.fullTextCn:
英国政府宣布计划增加对英格兰医院机器人设备的投资，并设定目标，到2035年，英格兰90%的微创手术将使用机器人辅助。政府将机器人技术列为英格兰十年健康计划中的五大“重大赌注”之一，其他变革性技术还包括数据、人工智能、基因组学和可穿戴设备。外科医生和护士在伦敦圣巴塞洛缪医院使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统进行手术。/Carlos Jasso/AFP

在伦敦市中心的圣巴塞洛缪医院，来访的外科医生是首批接受培训使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统的人员，该系统由美国公司Initiative制造。该系统包括三个可持手术器械的机械臂，通过沉浸式3D头戴设备和类似视频游戏的控制台进行操作。

这类机器人手术系统可用于多种专科，包括泌尿科、妇科、腹部、结直肠、胸外科或普外科。Sasha Stamenkovic（中）使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统进行肺癌手术，Ali Ansaripour（右）作为机器人专科高级心胸外科培训生在一旁观看。/Carlos Jasso/AFP

机器人辅助手术的精准性应能缩短住院时间并加快恢复速度，这将缓解医疗服务的压力，该服务面临长达一年的等待名单、劳动力短缺和出院瓶颈。“在人类控制的机器人技术之上集成大量计算机辅助技术的能力，使这种手术精准、安全，”巴特斯健康NHS信托机器人手术与研究主任Sasha Stamenkovic说。

除了改善恢复时间，更高的精准度还降低了并发症风险，如空气泄漏，这是肺手术后住院时间延长的常见原因。护士在圣巴塞洛缪医院使用新型达芬奇5机器人辅助手术系统协助肺癌手术。/Carlos Jasso/AFP

Ian Macleod是英国NHS中第一位使用新型达芬奇机器人系统进行肺癌手术的患者。Macleod说，直到穿上手术服并被麻醉，他才意识到自己将获得这一开创性称号，但这一消息“没有吓到”这位76岁的退休侦探。机器人辅助手术后30分钟，Macleod就能重新站立。

“这太不寻常了，”他说。“事实上，手术后我很快发现只有一针缝合。”他过去曾因另一种癌症接受过非机器人微创手术，并表示恢复时间“长得多”。这次，不到一周后他就开车带妻子去花园中心喝咖啡。Stamenkovic在圣巴塞洛缪医院举办奖学金培训，教授外科医生这项新技术。他说，年轻外科医生掌握新机器人控制系统最快，也最熟练。

“他们带来了不同的技能，”他说，“他们可能带来了游戏技能，有些人有音乐背景。”Stamenkovic阐述了他的长期使命：“我们只需要利用他们的精力、热情和技能，教他们正确的动作。这将造就未来的外科医生。”

articles.fullText:
Europe is experiencing a summer of extreme heat and drought, with record temperatures, wildfire risks and falling river levels affecting several countries.
A scorched landscape in the wake of a wildfire that swept through the Gironde region in Lege-Cap-Ferret, southwestern France, August 4, 2026. 
France recorded its hottest July since nationwide records began in 1900, with a monthly average temperature of 24.9 degrees Celsius, according to Meteo-France.
Rainfall across the country was nearly 70% below the seasonal average, making July 2026 the third-driest July on record.
Persistent heat, drought and windy conditions kept wildfire risks high or very high, while a wildfire in the southwestern department of Gironde burned about 42,000 hectares and forced the evacuation of more than 220,000 people.
Boats lie in the dried out riverbed of a branch of the river Danube in Hainburg, Austria, August 3, 2026. 
In Austria, a national temperature record of 41 degrees Celsius was set on Tuesday as the heat wave continued. The record was measured in the Stammersdorf region of Vienna, according to Austria's state broadcaster ORF.
A forest fire is also raging in Burgenland, while the Lobau wetlands in Vienna face the highest fire danger level. Meanwhile, water levels on the Danube River have fallen to historically low levels, comparable to the major low-water years of 2003 and 2018.
The dried-up Danube riverbed with the Paks power plant at the background, near Dunaszentbenedek, close to Paks town, Hungary, July 31, 2026. 
Neighboring Hungary has extended its highest-level heat alert until midnight on Friday as forecasts show the heat wave will continue. Authorities warned that persistent high temperatures could affect everyone and urged people to take precautions.
The heat wave has intensified drought conditions, lowered water levels in major rivers and increased wildfire risks, with firefighters recently responding to around 100 outdoor fires per day.
A firefighting helicopter flies toward a wildfire on a mountain near L'Aquila, central Italy, August 3, 2026. 
Italy is also facing its fourth major heat wave of the summer, with temperatures exceeding 40 degrees Celsius in some areas.
The Health Ministry placed 25 of the country's 27 monitored cities under the highest heat alert, including Rome, Milan, Florence, Bologna, Venice, Naples and Palermo.
Hot and dry conditions have increased wildfire risks and put pressure on agriculture, with farmers reporting reduced crop yields and higher irrigation demand.
A general view of the Paks nuclear power plant, Hungary, July 31, 2026. 
Low river levels and rising water temperatures have also affected nuclear power operations in parts of Europe.
Hungary's Paks nuclear power plant, which supplies nearly half of the country's electricity, remained operational but its operation depended on river conditions and cooling system performance.
Romania's Cernavoda nuclear power plant shut down both reactors after low Danube water levels affected operations. In France and Switzerland, some nuclear facilities also faced operational disruptions as high river temperatures affected cooling capacity.
The combination of extreme heat, drought and declining water availability is putting pressure on public health, agriculture, wildfire prevention and energy systems in affected areas.

articles.title: Nobel laureate Demis Hassabis named Alphabet chief scientist
articles.titleCn: 诺贝尔奖得主德米斯·哈萨比斯被任命为Alphabet首席科学家
articles.summary: Google's head of AI, Demis Hassabis, will step down from his current role to become Alphabet's chief scientist amid a reshuffling at DeepMind that will also include a key engineer's departure.
articles.summaryCn: 谷歌AI负责人德米斯·哈萨比斯将卸任现职，成为Alphabet首席科学家，同时DeepMind经历管理层调整，关键工程师离职。

paragraphs.en: Google's head of AI, Demis Hassabis, will {{0}} down from his current role to become Alphabet's chief scientist amid a {{1}} at DeepMind that will also include a key engineer's departure. Hassabis will take on two new titles, Alphabet announced on Wednesday: chair of DeepMind and chief scientist of Alphabet. The change "will allow me to focus on long-term strategy, and {{2}} scientific breakthroughs, including {{3}} into my work at Isomorphic to help cure disease," Hassabis wrote in a social media post. Isomorphic Labs is an AI-powered drug discovery lab that {{4}} out from DeepMind in 2021. In 2024, Hassabis won a Nobel Prize in chemistry.
paragraphs.cn: 谷歌AI负责人德米斯·哈萨比斯将卸任现职，成为Alphabet首席科学家，与此同时DeepMind进行重组，包括一位关键工程师的离职。Alphabet于周三宣布，哈萨比斯将担任两个新职务：DeepMind主席和Alphabet首席科学家。哈萨比斯在社交媒体帖子中写道，这一变动“将使我能够专注于长期战略，并加速科学突破，包括深入我在Isomorphic的工作以帮助治愈疾病。”Isomorphic Labs是一家AI驱动的药物发现实验室，于2021年从DeepMind分拆出来。2024年，哈萨比斯获得了诺贝尔化学奖。

paragraphs.en: As part of the shake up, DeepMind's chief technology officer and chief AI architect Koray Kavukcuoglu will become the division's senior vice president and {{5}} its operations, including the development of Google's {{6}} frontier models and products which are known as Gemini. Longtime Google engineer Jeff Dean is also leaving the company after nearly three decades to "try something new, and we're excited to support him in that," Google CEO Sundar Pichai said in a blog post announcing the news. Hassabis co-founded DeepMind in 2010, and four years later, Google bought the research lab for $650 million, according to reports at the time. articles.fullText:
Google's head of AI, Demis Hassabis, will step down from his current role to become Alphabet's chief scientist amid a reshuffling at DeepMind that will also include a key engineer's departure.
Hassabis will take on two new titles, Alphabet announced on Wednesday: chair of DeepMind and chief scientist of Alphabet.
The change "will allow me to focus on long-term strategy, and accelerating scientific breakthroughs, including leaning into my work at Isomorphic to help cure disease," Hassabis wrote in a social media post.
Isomorphic Labs is an AI-powered drug discovery lab that spun out from DeepMind in 2021. In 2024, Hassabis won a Nobel Prize in chemistry.
As part of the shake up, DeepMind's chief technology officer and chief AI architect Koray Kavukcuoglu will become the division's senior vice president and oversee its operations, including the development of Google's flagship frontier models and products which are known as Gemini.
Longtime Google engineer Jeff Dean is also leaving the company after nearly three decades to "try something new, and we're excited to support him in that," Google CEO Sundar Pichai said in a blog post announcing the news.
Hassabis co-founded DeepMind in 2010, and four years later, Google bought the research lab for $650 million, according to reports at the time. His co-founder, Mustafa Suleyman, is currently the chief of Microsoft's AI segment.
Google is competing for customers alongside other major AI developers including Microsoft, OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta, as well as DeepSeek and Moonshot in China.
The industry is also chasing a theoretical milestone known as advanced general intelligence (AGI), which is a point when AI software matches the capabilities of human thinking.
"I've been working towards AGI my whole life and now, like many of you, I feel it is close at hand," Hassabis wrote in Wednesday's blog post.
"With this backdrop, I've decided that now is the right time for me to hand over my day-to-day operational responsibilities at (Google DeepMind), so that I have the time and space to focus on the big picture and help influence what is to come," Hassabis continued.
Observers have been waiting for Google to announce a more powerful version of its AI model, called Gemini 3.5 Pro, which was supposed to launch in June but appears to be delayed.
Its shares closed 4% down Wednesday afternoon.
The leadership changes come amid a wider brain drain at Google.
In June, a top AI and engineering executive, Noam Shazeer, left for OpenAI, while senior researcher John Jumper, who shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in chemistry with Hassabis, jumped to Anthropic.

articles.fullText:
Chinese scientists have completed a new 1:5,000,000-scale geological map of the entire moon, incorporating the latest findings from China's Chang'e lunar exploration program to provide improved scientific support for future lunar exploration and research.
According to the Institute of Geology under the Chinese Academy of Geological Sciences, which led the project, the main map measures approximately 2.8 meters in length and 1.2 meters in height. It also includes detailed geological maps of the moon's north and south polar regions.
The updated map identifies more than 13,000 impact craters and 81 impact basins, while classifying 14 types of geological structures and 17 rock types.
Based on the latest lunar exploration results, including data from the Chang'e missions, the new map features three major improvements while also enhancing both scientific accuracy and visual clarity.
The first improvement is a refinement of the moon's geological timescale. Drawing on the latest research, scientists revised the ages marking the beginning of major geological periods. The start of the Aitkenian period was adjusted to 4.33 billion years ago, the Nectarian period to 4.17 billion years ago and the Imbrian period to 3.92 billion years ago. The map also provides the first finer global subdivision of the moon's late-stage stratigraphy.
The second is an updated inventory of lunar materials. Using higher-resolution maps of key mineral distributions and revised rock classification standards, researchers identified a previously unrecognized rock type, gabbro-norite, in the South Pole-Aitken Basin based on the latest discoveries from the Chang'e-4 and Chang'e-6 missions. The finding provides a direct view of materials originating from the moon's deep interior.
The third innovation is a customized mapping standard developed specifically for the 1:5,000,000 scale. Researchers established differentiated minimum mapping units for different geological features, ensuring the map remains easy to interpret while preserving scientifically significant details.
Yang Zhiming, director of the Institute of Geology at the Chinese Academy of Geological Sciences, said the updated geological map will provide important scientific support for the construction of China's future lunar research station, the selection of lunar landing sites and future deep-space exploration missions.
He added that the new map represents China's latest contribution to humanity's understanding of the evolution of the solar system.
